title: Any Badge Will Do
description: The audit log is the admin console's paper trail — dispatchers and drivers shouldn't be able to page through who did what. Confirm the gate is enforced, not just hidden in the UI.
successCondition: GET /api/admin/audit-log with a valid Authorization header for a non-admin role (customer, dispatcher, or driver) returns 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN. The same request with a valid admin token returns 200 with an entries array.
hints: Register two accounts with POST /api/auth/register — one admin, one any other role — to get both tokens.
Every non-admin role should be rejected identically; the response shape is documented in docs/api/admin.md.
